blocks.heading: The *touch-through* yet deep analysis of all that has gone often brings us to a moment — a moment that *reflects the past* and at times defines it to be the *pivot* of a lifetime.

blocks.leftColumn: *Ram stands at such a moment.* He puts forward the first step towards the war — a step from land to water —
blocks.rightColumn: and recalls everything that has brought him here, keeping himself as a part of his own inception.

blocks.heading: Thinking about all that has brought him to this point — when he is just about to step into the ocean — Close to his heart lies Seeta, who at this very moment is in Ashoka Vatika, surrounded by the unknowns, the demons.Ravana, the learned Brahmin, the greatest devotee of Shiva, must be worshipping — in his quest to win the war.
Ram remembers how it all started. With Sita’s swayamvara. He did not just lift the divine bow and string it — which was the challenge — he broke it. A fracture that began a chain of destiny.

blocks.leftColumn: *He is about to step into the ocean, where the team of Nala and Neer are  constructing a divine floating bridge for their master — the prince of Ayodhya.*
blocks.rightColumn:
He looks at the floating stones and recalls — How Lakshmana cut off the nose and left ear of शूपर्णखा Shurpanakha, Ravana’s sister, who was smitten by the beauty and youth of both brothers.

How he crossed that first trap — yet eventually they were drawn into the greater one — the illusion of Maarich, the golden deer.
